critique.evidence: Desktop and tablet show a polished dark technical aesthetic: the oversized headline establishes clear hierarchy, cyan/green/yellow accents are controlled, the grid and orbital vault graphic feel cohesive, and metric panels are consistently styled. Mobile materially breaks that polish: the “HIDE SCOPE EVIDENCE” control extends beyond the right edge, the two-column recall panel clips the known-recall value and caption, long artifact/hash text is truncated, and dense small low-contrast copy reduces readability. These visible overflow issues prevent the screen from being hackathon-demo ready across all three viewports.
critique.fix: Add a true mobile layout: stack the recall metrics into one column, make the evidence button fit within the card, wrap or safely truncate long identifiers with accessible expansion, and reduce inner padding/type scale where needed. Increase contrast and line height for small supporting text while preserving the strong desktop visual system.
